mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendances (enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, status, remarks) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{lectureDate}, #{period}, #{status}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendances SET status = #{status}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.enrollment_id, u.name as student_name, c.name as course_name, a.lecture_date, a.period, a.status, a.remarks FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN users u ON e.student_id = u.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id WHERE a.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} ORDER BY a.lecture_date DESC, a.period ASC

SELECT a.id, a.enrollment_id, u.name as student_name, c.name as course_name, a.lecture_date, a.period, a.status, a.remarks FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN users u ON e.student_id = u.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id WHERE l.id = #{lectureId} AND a.lecture_date = #{date} ORDER BY u.name ASC, a.period ASC
